meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions "grill me".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对计划或设计方案进行深度追问与压力测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要被严格追问来澄清和验证你的计划
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test a plan or design through relentless questioning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to be grilled to clarify and validate your plan

howto.what: 装上后，当你想让Claude对你的计划或设计进行严格盘问时，它会一次只问一个问题，并给出推荐答案，直到双方达成共识。如果问题能通过浏览代码库回答，它会自动去查。
howto.when: 当你想压力测试一个计划、被盘问设计，或者说出“grill me”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我盘问我的创业计划，找出漏洞。
say.note: Claude会逐个追问计划的每个细节。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you want Claude to relentlessly interview you about a plan or design, it will ask one question at a time, provide its recommended answer, and explore the codebase if needed, until reaching shared understanding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to stress-test a plan, get grilled on your design, or mention "grill me".

say_en.text: Grill me on my startup plan and find weak points.
say_en.note: Claude will question every aspect step by step.
Claude will ask one decision question at a time with recommendations.
